title: [Hiring] Client Relationship Analyst / Creator & Social | Remote Brazil | $1000 USD/mo + commission
description:
Remote creator / social management agency. We work with creators in the US and LATAM. Small team, real promotions in weeks or months.

Not an account-manager title. You look after clients already with us: follow-up, alignment, flag issues early. Work is in English all day. We train you. People who deliver move up fast.

What you'll do: - Point of contact for a small book of creators - Keep work moving and flag blockers early - Light reporting and follow-up with the team

Need: - Based in Brazil, fully remote - Native Portuguese - Near-native English (we'll screen with a short English voice note) - Gen-Z native and fluent in that culture - Junior ok. CS, account coord, or agency is a plus - Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm Brasília time

Pay: $1,000 USD/month guaranteed base + commission. Typical $1,500+ from month 3–4 (never commission-only).

Apply: reply to this post in English with LinkedIn or CV + 5 lines on why you.
